source: Fresh official rows outside declared combined Ripper/H4ak ledger through H1bo; each 180-row bank without replacement, crossbank repeats retained.
acquisition: One uniform72-cell subset per row in control. Balanced arm queries complements of the 90 affine lines in GF(9)^2 twice. Each cycle independently randomizes all81 cell identities and all90 line positions; permutations independent of source IDs, labels and noise. Common 180 clean source rows and one iid5 latent noise stream per bank. Seal all IDs then both full mask streams for all32 banks before selected CSV labels. No label feedback, donors, row selection or rescue.
balanced_construction: GF(9)=GF(3)[t]/(t^2+1), encoded a+3b for a+b*t. Points (x,y) encode 9*x+y. Lines y=m*x+b for all9 slopes and9 intercepts, then9 vertical lines x=b. Each omitted line has9points; each point belongs to10lines; each distinct pair shares1line. One90-row queried-complement cycle gives71 coqueries/pair and80queries/cell; two cycles give142 and160 exactly, even with independent cell permutations.
noise: One fresh mask-independent iid cell-error realization per full180-row bank: uniforms then offsets1..8; add offset mod9 iffU<0.05. Both masks view the same latent noisy board. Noise parameter not supplied to estimator.
decision: Each endpoint assessed separately. Recovery lower=S_b, upper=S_b+U_b. Contrast lower=S_b-(S_u+U_u), upper=(S_b+U_b)-S_u. Supported iff lower>=target; falsified iff upper<target; otherwise inconclusive. Any uncertified griddegree makesbank unresolved; selectedfractional/nonexact isfailure. Runtime failure incomplete.
